message:
The users test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 fails.

The test failed with `unknown column users.full_name`. The users migration (`migrations/001_create_users.js`) creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` was writing and reading `full_name`. I changed the API to use `fullname` in both `createUser` and `getUser`. I left `migrations/` alone, as `CLAUDE.md` requires.
text: Fenceline: no fence crossed this turn.
